text:
Mawlynnong is a village in the East Khasi Hills district of the Meghalaya state in North East India. It is notable for its cleanliness and also was chosen by Discover India magazine as Asia's cleanest village.
The village comes under the Pynursla community development block and Vidhan Sabha (legislative assembly) constituency.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Meghalaya (Pronounced MAY-ghah-LUH-yuh)is one of the seven North-Eastern states of India. Famous for its high rainfall, subtropical forests and biodiversity, it is abutted by Assam in the north and east and by Bangladesh in the south. The river Brahmaputra (or Luit as called locally) forms the border in the west. Most of the terrain is hilly and experiences heavy rainfall during monsoons.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
